name: Pitti Engineering Ltd
about: Pitti Engg. is engaged in the manufacturing of Electrical Steel Laminations, Motor Cores, Sub-Assemblies, Die-Cast Rotors, Press Tools and machining of metal components.
keyPoints:
Market Leadership
The company is India's largest manufacturer and exporter of electrical laminations and a leading supplier of complicated sub-assemblies for motors and generators. [1]

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 44.6% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -5.10%
